run_ade_classification_k_shot: run the AdeCorpusV2_Classfication module to generate 16-shot k-shot data splits for multiple random seeds
create_classification_dataset: create an AdeCorpusV2_Classfication dataset instance that loads the ADE Corpus V2 classification task from HuggingFace
load_ade_corpus_dataset: load the ADE Corpus V2 classification dataset using datasets.load_dataset with the AdeCorpusV2_Classfication class
split_train_test_lines: split the ADE Corpus V2 training data into 80/20 train and test sets using get_train_test_lines
map_hf_dataset_to_list: map a HuggingFace dataset split to a list of text and label tuples using map_hf_dataset_to_list
